What I do

SEO for Shopify and WooCommer stores.

/ 01

Content & AI-Overview strategy

Research that matches search intent, briefs that writers love, and outlines that earn snippets. Each page is made to work on classic search results and AI summaries.

/ 02

E-commerce SEO

Collections, articles, faceted nav, internal links, and review SEO for Shopify and Woo. Clean URLs and metadata that grow with your store and help it convert.

/ 03

On-page SEO

Pages built for clarity, relevance, and conversion. I handle keyword placement, page structure, internal links, and SEO-ready titles and metadata.

/ 04

Keyword research

High-value keywords with strong intent. I build smart clusters, check difficulty, and pick the terms that bring traffic and sales.

How I work

From keyword to top of the page.

Research

Find the main keyword and the related terms real customers type in.

Study intent

Look at the top pages to learn what Google wants to see.

Optimize

Write the SEO title, meta, and structured content. Add internal links, images, and alt text.

Publish & track

Check headings, URLs, and readability. Then watch the results and improve.
